name: N-best
description: A benchmark evaluation dataset for assessing automatic speech recognition performance on Northern and Southern Dutch speech varieties.
reputation: An established Interspeech (2007) dataset used in Dutch ASR research to evaluate regional (Northern vs Southern) variants, though smaller and less used than modern large-scale corpora.
notes: Relatively small corpus, contains regional accent variation (Northern vs Southern Dutch), non-LLM benchmark; potential domain shift versus contemporary conversational datasets.
